def build_section_5(doc):
    add_heading_1(doc, "SECTION V: RECOMMENDED INTERVIEW SEQUENCING AND CROSS-VERIFICATION STRATEGY")

    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "A critical strategic determination in conducting an internal factual investigation is the sequencing of witness examinations. "
        "The order in which witnesses are interviewed directly governs counsel's ability to verify assertions against objective records, protect "
        "attorney-client privilege, prevent witness collusion or narrative adaptation, and progressively build factual leverage. Based on the "
        "evidentiary status of the available materials, the scope of privilege, and the comparative knowledge of the witnesses, the defense "
        "team recommends the following three-stage investigative sequence:",
        bold_prefix="Investigative Rationale: "
    )

    # 5.1 The Recommended Sequence Overview
    add_heading_2(doc, "5.1 Recommended Investigative Sequence Overview")

    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "Stage 1 (FIRST): Meridian Legal Lead (Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal)\n"
        "Stage 2 (SECOND): Meridian Technical Team (Module Architects & Lead Developers)\n"
        "Stage 3 (LAST): Dr. Marcus Holt (Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder)",
        bold_prefix="Sequential Order: "
    )

    add_callout(
        doc,
        "STRATEGIC JUSTIFICATION SUMMARY: Interviewing the Legal Lead first establishes an uncompromised document preservation baseline, "
        "secures corporate governance records, and identifies the relevant technical contributors without intruding into privileged legal opinions. "
        "Interviewing the Technical Team second establishes an objective, code-level record of independent development, commit histories, and "
        "open-source usage directly from the developers who wrote the software. Interviewing Dr. Marcus Holt last ensures that counsel possesses "
        "complete mastery over the objective documentary and codebase record, maximizing cross-examination leverage and preventing Dr. Holt from "
        "tailoring his testimony regarding the contested February 2018 forensic events.",
        bold_title="CORE SEQUENCING METHODOLOGY:"
    )

    # 5.2 Detailed Step-by-Step Rationale and Cross-Verification Methodology
    add_heading_2(doc, "5.2 Detailed Step-by-Step Rationale and Cross-Verification Mechanics")

    add_heading_3(doc, "Stage 1 (First): Meridian Legal Lead (Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal)")
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "Examining Mr. Kessler as the opening interview serves three indispensable foundational functions:",
        bold_prefix="Foundational Role: "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "1. Securing Preservation and Audit Readiness: Before substantive fact witnesses are interviewed—and before any risk of spoliation can be "
        "alleged—counsel must confirm that comprehensive, written litigation holds were properly issued, that auto-deletion schedules on email, "
        "Slack, and Git servers were suspended, and that forensic images of key custodian hardware were securely captured. Establishing this "
        "defensible preservation trail at the outset protects Meridian against spoliation sanctions under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 37(e).",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "2. Defining Privilege and Procedural Boundaries: Mr. Kessler is the corporate gatekeeper of legal communications. Interviewing him first "
        "allows outside counsel to delineate the exact boundaries between discoverable factual events (e.g., date of receipt of the March 12 C&D "
        "letter, employee onboarding forms, third-party software scans) and privileged legal work product (e.g., legal risk assessments, outside "
        "counsel advice, defense theories). This ensures all subsequent internal communications adhere strictly to privilege protocols.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "3. Gathering Baseline Corporate & Personnel Documents: The Legal Lead can provide the foundational corporate records needed for subsequent "
        "interviews: standard employee PIIAs, employee handbooks, the complete pre-suit correspondence file, ordinary-course patent clearance "
        "searches, and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan reports. Furthermore, Mr. Kessler can supply an objective organizational chart "
        "identifying which engineers worked on which specific modules, eliminating reliance on Dr. Holt's subjective characterization of the team.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )

    add_heading_3(doc, "Stage 2 (Second): Meridian Technical Team (Module Architects & Lead Developers)")
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "Examining the technical team prior to Dr. Holt provides an untainted, empirical engineering baseline:",
        bold_prefix="Objective Technical Baseline: "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "1. Independent Verification of Code Provenance: Module architects and lead developers possess direct, firsthand knowledge of how the "
        "code was conceived, designed, and implemented. By examining them before Dr. Holt, counsel obtains an authentic, uncolored account of "
        "the engineering process. Their testimony will establish whether developers wrote the code from scratch, what academic literature they "
        "consulted, and whether Dr. Holt provided high-level architectural requirements or hands-on code.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "2. Interrogation of Git Commit Histories and Repositories: With repository commit logs and Jira tickets in hand (secured during Stage 1), "
        "counsel can review specific commits, author tags, and branch mergers directly with the authors. This creates an objective timeline showing "
        "that the Sensor Fusion module (Q3 2018 - Q4 2019), GPS-denied VIO module (Q1 2019 - Q3 2020), and Swarm protocol (Q2 2019 - Q1 2021) were "
        "developed incrementally over several years, conclusively disproving SkyVault's theory of a wholesale 2018 code drop.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "3. Methodical Evaluation of Public Literature Across Eight Modes: The technical team can speak authoritatively to how Vasquez (2016), "
        "DroneNav (GitHub 2017), Nakamura & Okonkwo (2015), and Ferreira et al. (2016) were actually treated in practice across all eight operational "
        "modes (awareness, citation, evaluation, cloning, dependency inclusion, modification, use, non-use). This confirms that open-source tools "
        "were either evaluated as prior art or segregated, and that no proprietary code was copied.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "4. Definitive Code Diff Verification: Technical leads can verify that SkyVault's asserted AeroCore firmware files (`navfusion.c`, "
        "`pathoptengine.h`, `swarm_proto.cpp`) are completely absent from PathForge, establishing an affirmative technical record before Dr. Holt is examined.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )

    add_heading_3(doc, "Stage 3 (Last): Dr. Marcus Holt (Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder)")
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "Dr. Marcus Holt must be interviewed last to achieve maximum cross-examination effectiveness and test his credibility against established facts:",
        bold_prefix="Confrontation and Testing: "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "1. Full Command of the Documentary Record: By the time counsel interviews Dr. Holt, counsel will possess the complete corporate governance "
        "file from Legal, the full Git repository commit history and Jira logs from Engineering, and the verified testimony of module leads regarding "
        "who wrote each line of code. Counsel can examine Dr. Holt with complete mastery of the facts, ensuring that any gaps, exaggerations, or "
        "inconsistencies in his narrative can be immediately identified and probed.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "2. Preventing Tailored Testimony: If Dr. Holt were interviewed first, he might be tempted to shape his account of PathForge's development "
        "to fit a defensive narrative, or minimize his involvement in certain areas. By interviewing the technical team first, counsel establishes an "
        "objective factual record that Dr. Holt cannot rewrite. Counsel can test whether Dr. Holt's recollection of his role aligns with what the "
        "codebase and his developers actually show.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "3. Surgical Confrontation on Forensic Log Events (Exhibit F): Dr. Holt is the sole individual who can explain the February 8/9, 2018 bulk "
        "transfer of 4,700 files to the SanDisk Ultra 128GB USB device, the local Confluence downloads (Rows 27-32), the access revocation on February 13, "
        "and the exit interview with HR Director Patel on February 15. Because counsel will already know from Stages 1 and 2 that none of those files "
        "ever surfaced in Meridian's repositories, counsel can confront Dr. Holt on the physical disposition and chain of custody of that USB device "
        "from a position of total tactical strength.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "4. Deposition Preparation and Credibility Assessment: Because Dr. Holt will unquestionably be SkyVault's primary deposition target and "
        "the central witness at trial, conducting his interview last allows counsel to evaluate his demeanor, composure, and truthfulness under rigorous, "
        "adversarial cross-examination conditions. Counsel can identify potential vulnerabilities and begin formulating comprehensive witness preparation strategies.",
        bold_prefix="• "
    )

    # 5.3 Document Retrieval Milestones Preceding Each Stage
    add_heading_2(doc, "5.3 Document Retrieval Milestones Preceding Each Interview Stage")
    add_paragraph(
        doc,
        "To operationalize this sequence, counsel must ensure that specific categories of documents are collected and reviewed prior to commencing "
        "each corresponding interview stage:",
        bold_prefix="Operational Pre-Requisites: "
    )
    
    milestones = [
        ("Prior to Stage 1 (Legal Lead Interview):",
         "Collect and review: (i) SkyVault Complaint and complete exhibit set (Exhibits A-G); (ii) March 12, 2024 C&D letter and April 5, 2024 "
         "response letter; (iii) Meridian Certificate of Incorporation (April 11, 2018); (iv) Standard Meridian employee handbook, PIIA forms, "
         "and written IP compliance policies; (v) Organizational chart and employee roster from 2018 to present."),
        
        ("Prior to Stage 2 (Technical Team Interviews):",
         "Collect and review: (i) PathForge source code repository trees and branch structures (Git/GitLab); (ii) Initial commit logs from April 2018 "
         "through September 2020; (iii) Jira project tickets and architecture decision records for Sensor Fusion, VIO, and Swarm modules; (iv) "
         "Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan logs; (v) Published text of Vasquez (2016), DroneNav repo commit history (Aug 15, 2017), Nakamura "
         "(2015), and Ferreira (2016); (vi) Raw telemetry and flight test records supporting White Paper Tables 0, 1, and 2."),
        
        ("Prior to Stage 3 (Dr. Marcus Holt Interview):",
         "Collect and review: (i) Dr. Holt's executed SkyVault ECIAA and Exhibit A Prior Inventions Disclosure (June 13, 2016); (ii) Dr. Holt's PhD "
         "dissertation (Georgia Tech 2015) and public commit history for RoboNav GitHub repo; (iii) Exhibit F IT Forensic Log extract and incident "
         "ticket INC-2018-00417 notes; (iv) Technical team interview transcripts and module provenance summaries; (v) Results of AST / code diff "
         "searches for `navfusion.c`, `pathoptengine.h`, and `swarm_proto.cpp`; (vi) Forensic image audit of Dr. Holt's Meridian-issued computing devices.")
    ]
    for lbl, desc in milestones:
        add_paragraph(doc, desc, bold_prefix=f"• {lbl} ")

rubric.reason: 产出中明确设有独立的“SECTION IV: WITNESS EXAMINATION OUTLINE — MERIDIAN LEGAL LEAD (JORDAN KESSLER, VP OF LEGAL)”章节，并包含角色说明及对应访谈问题。

rubric.criterion: Each witness section begins with a short role statement before listing questions.
rubric.reason: 三类证人章节均在问题列表前以简短完整句说明访谈角色：Holt 章节说明其提供任职、访问、离职及 PathForge 起源的一手事实；技术团队章节说明其用于建立开发来源与模块记录；法务负责人章节说明其作为合规、治理及诉前沟通记录保管人的作用。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates Holt's SkyVault role and employment-period line in the complaint.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分明确引用并定位了诉状中的任职信息。例如 Q4 的 Source 引用“skyvault-complaint.docx ¶ 5, 21, 43”，并说明其中包括 Holt 的入职日期；该问题同时明确其在 SkyVault 担任 Senior Systems Engineer、于 2016 年 6 月 13 日入职。另 Q12 引用诉状 ¶53 并结合材料定位其离职后时间线。因此该节确实定位了 Holt 在 SkyVault 的角色及任职期间线索。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section uses the SkyVault role and employment-period line as the starting point for access, departure-period conduct, and later development-role questions.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分明确以其在 SkyVault 的职位和任职期间为起点，并据此展开访问权限（Q4-Q6）、离职前后的下载/USB/权限撤销/退出访谈与材料处置（Q7-Q11），以及离职后 Meridian 创立和 PathForge 开发角色（Q12-Q13、Q15 等）的问题。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates the January 10 FlightPath Confluence download and the February 5 FlightPath bulk-export records in the forensic log.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分未具体定位或询问 1 月 10 日的 FlightPath Confluence 下载记录。Q7 虽以 Exhibit F 的 Rows 27–32 概括包含 2 月 5 日在内的批量导出，但未弥补 1 月 10 日记录的缺失。

rubric.criterion: The Holt FlightPath questions seek the access purpose, file scope, and later disposition of the downloaded materials.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分的 Q7 询问包括 FlightPath 在内的 Confluence 批量导出的目的及授权情况；Q8 进一步询问实际传输了哪些文件及原因；Q11 询问离职后 USB 及 SkyVault 下载材料的保留、删除或转移情况，覆盖访问目的、文件范围和后续处置。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates the SensorFusion view records in the forensic log, including the January 11 view of sf_lidar_integration_notes.docx.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分虽概括引用了 Exhibit F 的 Rows 1–26 并提及 /SensorFusion/，但未具体定位或提及 1 月 11 日查看 sf_lidar_integration_notes.docx 的记录。

rubric.criterion: The Holt SensorFusion questions test the relationship between the view record and a specific work assignment or authorized explanation.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分仅概括询问其对 SensorFusion 等 Confluence 空间的通常权限（Q5），并询问批量导出的目的及授权（Q7）；没有针对某一具体 SensorFusion 文件查看记录，要求其说明与特定工作任务或具体授权理由之间的关系。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates the ECIAA disclosure of pre-employment ground path-planning work.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分第 Q1 题明确定位至 `holt-eciaa-agreement.docx` 的 Exhibit A（Table 0, Row 1），并指出其中披露并排除了其入职前的 “Autonomous Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm (2014–2015)”。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates the ECIAA disclosure of the RoboNav sensor-calibration tool.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分的 Q2 明确将“RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit”定位至 holt-eciaa-agreement.docx 的 Exhibit A（Table 0, Row 2），并注明其为 GitHub 上以 MIT License 发布的既有披露。

rubric.criterion: The Holt prior-work questions ask for content, origin, contributors, pre-SkyVault records, and relationship to PathForge without presuming overlap.
rubric.reason: Holt questions Q1–Q3 address the prior work’s technical content, origin, public availability, and use at SkyVault, and later collection items seek dissertation/Git records. However, they do not ask who contributed to the prior inventions or directly explore their relationship to PathForge—such as whether and how they informed, differed from, or were incorporated into PathForge—without presuming overlap.

rubric.criterion: The PathForge development questions locate the whitepaper's stated development-start timing.
rubric.reason: PathForge 开发问题明确定位了白皮书所述的开发起始时间。例如 Q13 引用白皮书 Section 7.2（“development timeline beginning April 2018”），Q28、Q31、Q34 又分别引用 Section 7.2 定位各模块从 Q3 2018、Q1 2019 和 Q2 2019 开始的开发周期。

rubric.criterion: The PathForge development-start questions seek early requirements, repositories, architecture materials, testing records, and personnel.
rubric.reason: PathForge 开发起点相关问题覆盖了全部要求：Q13 询问早期技术问题、来源材料及初始系统规格；Q27-Q28 询问代码仓库、初始提交记录和具体开发人员；Q29、Q31-Q35 询问各模块架构与实现；Q30、Q33 询问测试协议、遥测、飞行记录及底层数据。

rubric.criterion: The Meridian technical-team section locates the whitepaper's DroneNav public-project reference.
rubric.reason: Meridian technical-team section Q37 expressly locates the DroneNav reference in `pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx`, citing “Section 2 (p. 2), Section 4.2 (p. 6), & References (Item 2)” and identifying the GitHub repository and first-commit date.

rubric.criterion: The Holt section locates the whitepaper authorship and title information for Holt.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分明确定位了白皮书标题与作者信息。例如 Q15 引用 `pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx, Title Page (p. 1)`，并写明标题为 “PathForge: Next-Generation Autonomous Navigation”，作者列为 Dr. Marcus Holt 与 “PathForge Engineering Team”。

rubric.criterion: The answer treats the whitepaper authorship and title information only as a lead for role, drafting, review, approval, or technical-information-supply questions.
rubric.reason: 产出将白皮书标题页所列“Dr. Marcus Holt and the PathForge Engineering Team”作为访谈线索，用于询问 Holt 的研究、起草和批准角色（Q15）以及工程团队的撰写、审阅和技术核实贡献（Q41）；同时明确要求区分实际技术作者与营销性表述，未将署名直接当作代码作者身份或技术内容真实性的证明。

rubric.criterion: The legal-lead section locates the counsel response made on behalf of Meridian and its officers and directors to SkyVault's demand letter.
rubric.reason: 法务负责人部分虽定位了2024年4月5日外部律师回函及其签署人，并询问律师聘任时间，但仅表述律师代表“the company”或Meridian，未明确指出该回函系同时代表Meridian及其 officers and directors 作出。Q47提到 officers 和 board members 仅涉及是否遭到直接联系，并非回函的代表范围。

rubric.criterion: The legal-lead questions use the counsel response to probe receipt, escalation, investigation, response authority, and materials reviewed.
rubric.reason: 法务负责人部分确实利用4月5日回函追问了来函收讫与流转（Q45）及聘请外部律师的升级过程（Q46），并涉及后续保全和取证措施（Q48-Q53）；但未明确询问谁授权或批准该回函，也未系统询问为起草、审阅该回函而调查了哪些事实、审阅了哪些材料，因此未完整覆盖该标准列出的各项。

rubric.criterion: The legal-lead section locates the response's visible cc line identifying Jordan Kessler as Meridian VP of Legal.
rubric.reason: 法律负责人部分的 Q45 将来源定位至 `meridian-cd-response.docx ¶ 7, 9, 25`，并明确注明该回函“cc'ing Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal”，满足对可见抄送行及其职务的定位要求。

rubric.criterion: The Jordan Kessler questions seek his role in receiving, reviewing, approving, or coordinating the response without assuming final authority.
rubric.reason: 法务负责人部分包含相关问题且未假定其具有最终决定权：Q45询问来函的实际接收日期、渠道及内部传阅对象；Q46询问聘请外部律师及协调形成4月5日回函的事实步骤；Q44涉及其对Holt协议的文件审查。问题聚焦接收、审查和协调等角色，没有把Kessler表述为最终批准或决策者。

rubric.criterion: The response uses open-ended wording for matters that can only be confirmed through interviews.
rubric.reason: 访谈提纲对需证人确认的事项普遍采用开放式问法，例如“please describe your doctoral research”“What was the purpose of these bulk exports, and who…authorized or knew about them?”以及“what factual steps did Meridian take…”。即使部分问题以“Did/Has”起始，通常也附有要求说明时间、原因、范围或具体经过的追问。

rubric.criterion: The response identifies missing records as interview-confirmation or document-request topics rather than confirmed facts.
rubric.reason: 产出明确将缺失材料转化为待确认或调取事项。第1.4节声明不得推定未提供文件支持任何一方，并列出代码库、开发记录、保全材料、内部沟通、完整取证数据等缺失类别；相关访谈问题询问其是否存在、内容及保存状态，第VI节又以DOC-01至DOC-10列出具体调取请求，而非将这些记录当作既成事实。

rubric.criterion: The memorandum provides questions that can actually be asked orally of the designated witnesses, rather than only topic headings, document lists or statements of desired findings.
rubric.reason: 备忘录按 Holt、技术团队和法务负责人分别列出了大量可直接口头提出的完整问句（Q1–Q55），如“please describe...”“what occurred...”“who...”“when...”，并非仅有主题标题、文件清单或预设结论。

rubric.criterion: The memo stays within the provided source universe and uses missing documents only as confirmation or production topics.
rubric.reason: 备忘录虽大多将缺失材料列为访谈确认或调取事项，但多处提前把尚未取得、核验的材料结果当作事实，例如称后续将已知“none of those files ever surfaced in Meridian's repositories”、提交记录将“conclusively”推翻指控，以及称 AeroCore v2.0 是在 Holt 离职后才“created”，而现有材料仅载明 2023 年登记。因此未完全遵守仅以五份材料为事实来源、缺失文件仅作确认或调取主题的限制。

rubric.criterion: The memo assigns witness topics to the witness category best positioned to answer them.
rubric.reason: 备忘录总体按证人知识范围合理分配主题：Holt 负责其任职、访问、离职、既有发明及个人参与事实；技术团队负责各模块开发、代码仓库、测试、依赖和开源使用；法务负责人负责公司合规、诉前来函接收与流转、保全及法律事务中的事实性事项，并明确排除特权法律意见。

rubric.criterion: The memo does not upgrade a limited interview-preparation record into a full infringement, provenance, preservation, or merits conclusion.
rubric.reason: 备忘录虽多次声明材料有限，但仍将调查线索升级为结论。例如称提交记录可“conclusively disproving”整体复制理论、代码比对可“Conclusively establish the complete absence” of AeroCore code，并称可“prove”完整独立开发、保存合规及无第三方代码污染。这些均超出了访谈准备记录能够支持的侵权、来源、保全或实体结论。

rubric.criterion: The answer states an evidence gap or unconfirmed point as a definite conclusion.
rubric.reason: 产出多次把待确认或缺失证据升级为确定结论。例如称技术团队访谈和提交记录将“conclusively disproving SkyVault's theory”，并预设后续“counsel will already know ... none of those files ever surfaced in Meridian's repositories”，但相关完整代码库、提交记录和技术比对尚未提供。另称 Holt “could not have accessed or copied”2023年登记的 v2.0，仅凭登记日期也不能确定版本创建时间或其内容。这些均属于将证据缺口或未确认事项表述为定论。

rubric.criterion: No non-empty, readable Microsoft Word (.docx) memorandum containing substantive, scorable text is submitted, including where the required file is missing, empty, corrupted, in the wrong file format, or wholly unreadable.
rubric.reason: modelResponse 明确提交了 Artifact: result.docx，并展示了大量可读、实质性的英文法律访谈备忘录内容；不存在文件缺失、空白、格式错误、损坏或完全不可读的情形。

rubric.criterion: The response is severely redundant, repeatedly restating the same facts, questions, sources, purposes, or cautions without adding a distinct interview function, thereby materially impairing the memorandum’s concision and usability.
rubric.reason: 备忘录存在严重重复并影响可用性：六组线索、证据边界、缺失文件调取、访谈顺序及特权提示均在正文、第五节、结论后的多项“PROTOCOL/DIRECTIVE”和第六节清单中反复陈述；DroneNav及公开文献的八种使用模式、白皮书引文差异、代码来源核查等问题也在Holt与技术团队部分高度重复，未形成足够不同的访谈功能。

rubric.criterion: The memorandum identifies Exhibit F as a 50-event selected extract from a stated 12,847-event review population for account mholt and limits it to SkyVault-side access, export, device, and response leads rather than treating it as a complete forensic record or proof of Meridian receipt or PathForge use.
rubric.reason: 备忘录明确将 Exhibit F 描述为针对账户“mholt”、从 12,847 条审计事件中选取的 50 条事件摘录，并指出其余 12,797 条未提供。文中仅将其用于 SkyVault 侧的访问、导出、USB 设备、权限撤销及离职处理线索，同时明确说明该摘录不能证明数据被转移给 Meridian、由 Meridian 接收或在 PathForge 中使用，也不构成完整取证记录。

rubric.criterion: The Holt interview reconciles the bulk removable-media event's 2018-02-09 02:18 UTC timestamp with its displayed February 8, 8:18 p.m. Central local time, or otherwise uses the timestamp without creating a false chronology.
rubric.reason: Holt Q8 does not correctly reconcile the timestamps. It cites Row 34 as “02/09/2018 08:18:12 PM (02/08 CT),” conflating the UTC date with the Central-time clock value. The correct reconciliation is 2018-02-09 02:18 UTC = February 8, 2018 at 8:18 p.m. Central.

rubric.criterion: Across its questions and annotations, the memorandum independently distinguishes pleaded allegations, the final counsel response's advocacy statements, the public White Paper's later marketing/technical assertions, operative ECIAA terms and disclosures, and logged forensic events, and does not use one source type as automatic proof of a different proposition.
rubric.reason: 虽然第1.2节明确区分了诉状主张、回函立场、白皮书陈述、ECIAA条款和Exhibit F日志，但后续问题及注释多次越过这些界限。例如Q22仅凭2023年版权登记日期即称AeroCore v2.0是“created and registered in 2023”；Q28、Q31和Q34将2022年白皮书所述开发时间线用于“prove”独立开发；排序部分又称提交记录将“conclusively”否定复制、AeroCore文件“completely absent”，而这些记录尚未取得或核验。因此并未在全文中持续避免把一种来源自动升级为另一命题的证明。

rubric.criterion: The memorandum recognizes that the complaint lists patents, a copyright registration, the ECIAA, Exhibit F and the White Paper, while the supplied universe does not include the patents, registration, full March 12 letter, source code, or a technical comparison, and therefore treats those missing materials as collection or confirmation needs rather than silently supplying their contents.
rubric.reason: 备忘录明确将诉状中的专利、版权登记及相关指控限定为 SkyVault 的未证实主张，并说明现有材料仅为五份文件。其明确指出完整的 3 月 12 日来函、PathForge/SkyVault 源代码、完整取证数据及 AST/逐行技术比对均未提供，并将完整附件、代码仓库、登记/专利相关事实确认及技术比对列为后续调取、证人确认或专家分析事项，而未将这些缺失材料的内容视为既定事实。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section connects the February 15 exit-interview/device note to ECIAA return, deletion, certification, and exit obligations, while asking Holt to confirm what occurred and avoiding treatment of the SkyVault administrator note as conclusive proof of breach.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分的 Q10 将 Exhibit F 第 46 行的 2 月 15 日退出面谈及 USB 备注与 ECIAA 第 3.5、4.4 节的退出和材料返还义务相连，并开放式询问会议中实际发生、被问及及其陈述。Q11 进一步依据 ECIAA 第 3.5(a)-(c) 节询问返还、删除/销毁及合规证明事项。其证明目的明确为“test the accuracy” of the HR note，未将该管理员备注视为违约的确定证据。

rubric.criterion: The Holt section addresses the January 24 view and/or February 8 bulk export from the Business/CustomerData space and seeks purpose, authorization, content and corroboration, using the log's 'outside normal Engineering scope' note as a lead rather than a legal conclusion.
rubric.reason: Holt 部分的 Q6 直接询问 2024? 更正：2018 年 1 月 24 日查看 Business/CustomerData 中 customer_contracts_summary_2017.xlsx 的原因及其是否属于工程职责；Q7 又询问包含该空间在内的 2 月批量导出的目的以及谁授权或知情。问题由此覆盖目的、授权、内容线索和可供佐证的知情人，并将该访问可能超出通常工程范围作为待核实事项，而未直接认定为盗用或违法。

rubric.criterion: The Holt questions distinguish the ECIAA's Confidential Information definition and invention-assignment provisions from its general-skills/public-information allowance and Exhibit A prior-invention disclosure, and seek records capable of applying those boundaries to later PathForge work.
rubric.reason: Holt 问题分别涉及 ECIAA 的保密信息例外（Q2 引用 §2.1）、一般技能与知识保留（Q3 引用 §3.4）、Exhibit A 既有发明及其排除（Q1-Q3 引用 §5.3 和 Exhibit A），并另行询问任职期间的发明转让义务（Q23 引用 §§5.1-5.2）。Q3、Q13 等进一步追问这些既有成果是否被带入 SkyVault 或后来用于 PathForge，且 DOC-02、DOC-03、DOC-04 要求调取既有代码历史、PathForge 提交记录及开发记录，以便将合同边界实际应用于后续 PathForge 工作。

rubric.criterion: The prior-work inquiry seeks contemporaneous substantiation for the disclosed Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm and RoboNav toolkit—such as dissertation, repository, contributor, release-date and license records—and does not confuse RoboNav with the White Paper's separate DroneNav reference.
rubric.reason: 产出对两项既有工作均要求同期佐证：Q1追问博士研究及Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm的具体算法、模型和软件，DOC-02要求调取2014–2015年博士论文；Q2追问RoboNav的起源、范围、公开时间、托管位置，并引用GitHub仓库及MIT许可证，DOC-02进一步要求Git提交历史。另Q19/Q37将DroneNav作为白皮书引用的独立开源项目单独询问，未与RoboNav混淆。

rubric.criterion: The technical-team questions seek a module-specific provenance chain for sensor fusion, GPS-denied navigation and swarm coordination, connecting contributors and source-code/repository history, including dependencies or their non-use, to both testing and release records and the records or custodians needed to verify those links. Shared questions expressly applied to each component, including a combined Navigation Module with distinguishable sensor-fusion and GPS-denied work, qualify; questions about record absence or dependency non-use are valid, without supplying invented record contents.
rubric.reason: 技术团队部分按传感器融合、GPS 拒止导航和群体协调分别提问了开发时间、具体贡献者、代码作者、初始提交及 Git 分支历史（Q28、Q31、Q34），并以共享问题追问仓库结构、独立发布周期及第三方依赖的引入、修改、使用或未使用（Q27、Q36-Q38）。Q30、Q33及访谈前调取清单要求核对测试数据、遥测和飞行记录，Q36询问各模块的独立发布周期；DOC-03、DOC-04、DOC-06等还列明了 Git/Jira/设计记录及相应 IT、DevOps、工程负责人等保管人，形成了可核验的模块级来源链。

rubric.criterion: The technical-team questions seek underlying test plans, raw results, approvals, drafts or source records for material White Paper performance and independent-development statements instead of treating the published figures or marketing conclusion as contemporaneous provenance proof.
rubric.reason: 技术团队问题明确要求追溯白皮书关键性能数据和独立开发陈述的底层记录，而非把公开白皮书直接当作同期来源证明。例如 Q30 询问 99.7% 检测率、38ms 延迟和 8cm RMS 精度所对应的“testing protocols, telemetry logs, and flight records”及底层数据集位置；Q33 要求提供 GPS 拒止导航基准的工程记录；Q28、Q31、Q34 则追问各模块的作者、初始提交日期、Git 分支历史和开发时间线。Q41 还追问白皮书技术声明的撰写、审阅和验证贡献。

rubric.criterion: The public-source questions separately investigate DroneNav and the cited academic works by Vasquez, Nakamura and Okonkwo, and Ferreira, seeking corroborating records that distinguish awareness, citation and evaluation from modification, use or non-use. The inquiry also distinguishes cloning and dependency introduction for software sources, while academic influences can be traced through design decisions and citations; naming sources alone is insufficient.

BRACKWELL & HAINES LLPCONFIDENTIAL LEGAL MEMORANDUM

TO:

Lead Litigation Partner, Intellectual Property Practice Group

FROM:

Special IP Litigation & Internal Factual Investigation Team

DATE:

October 14, 2024

RE:

Privileged Witness-Interview Outline and Fact-Finding Investigation Plan: SkyVault Technologies LLC v. Meridian Dynamics, Inc., Civil Action No. 2:24-cv-00817-JRG (E.D. Tex.)

PRIVILEGE:

ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT // ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGED // PREPARED IN ANTICIPATION OF LITIGATION



MANDATORY INVESTIGATION BOUNDARY & PRIVILEGE PROTOCOL: ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT // STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL // SUBJECT TO ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGE. This memorandum sets forth an internal witness-interview design and factual investigation strategy prepared by outside litigation counsel for Meridian Dynamics, Inc. in response to the complaint filed by SkyVault Technologies LLC on October 2, 2024. This document is strictly an interview outline and preparation guide. It does NOT constitute completed witness depositions, formal responsive pleadings, patent infringement/invalidity contentions, settlement correspondence, or a final substantive opinion on the merits. All factual hypotheses herein must be tested against documentary evidence and witness confirmation.



SECTION I: INVESTIGATIVE CONTEXT, EVIDENTIARY BOUNDARIES, AND METHODOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK

1.1 Procedural Posture, Investigative Purpose, and Scope Boundaries

On October 2, 2024, SkyVault Technologies LLC ('SkyVault') initiated a multi-count intellectual property lawsuit against Meridian Dynamics, Inc. ('Meridian') in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, Marshall Division (Civil Action No. 2:24-cv-00817-JRG). The Complaint asserts nine causes of action: infringement of three United States utility patents (U.S. Patent Nos. 10,234,561; 10,891,227; and 11,402,889); trade secret misappropriation under both the Defend Trade Secrets Act (18 U.S.C. § 1836) and the Texas Uniform Trade Secrets Act (Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code § 134A.001 et seq.); copyright infringement of SkyVault's AeroCore Firmware Suite under 17 U.S.C. § 501; breach of an Employee Confidentiality and Invention Assignment Agreement ('ECIAA') entered into by Dr. Marcus Holt; unjust enrichment; and common law unfair competition. Notably, while Dr. Marcus Holt is the focal actor across SkyVault's substantive allegations, Meridian Dynamics, Inc. is named as the sole corporate defendant.

This litigation follows an exchange of pre-suit correspondence in the spring of 2024. Specifically, on March 12, 2024, SkyVault's litigation counsel, Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP, transmitted a cease-and-desist letter to Meridian's Chief Executive Officer, Priya Chandrasekaran, demanding the immediate cessation of commercial operations regarding Meridian's PathForge platform, the payment of a $15 million licensing fee, and unfettered access to Meridian's proprietary source code repositories for a forensic audit. On April 5, 2024, Meridian's outside counsel, Laura Brackwell of Brackwell & Haines LLP, issued a formal response letter denying all claims of patent infringement, trade secret misappropriation, and copyright infringement, declining each of SkyVault's demands as legally and factually unsupported, asserting that PathForge was developed independently, and reserving all rights and defenses.

To properly prepare Meridian's defense, develop responsive pleadings, evaluate early motion-to-dismiss and transfer opportunities, and formulate a robust discovery plan, the handling partner has directed the litigation team to conduct an internal, privileged factual investigation. The explicit mandate of this memorandum is to design a comprehensive witness interview outline. This document establishes what questions to ask key witnesses, the evidentiary and legal significance of each question, and the precise factual leads derived from the five case materials currently provided. Counsel must strictly observe that this memorandum is an investigative blueprint—not a completed deposition transcript, pleading, infringement contention chart, settlement communication, or substantive merits opinion.

1.2 Strict Evaluation of the Evidentiary Scope and Limits of Supplied Materials

Evidentiary Precaution: A foundational principle of this investigation is that counsel must rigorously evaluate the actual legal and evidentiary weight of each material provided in the initial case file. No document may be accepted at face value, and no allegation, assertion, or selective extract may be treated as an established fact. Counsel must operate under the following evidentiary boundaries:

1. SkyVault Complaint (skyvault-complaint.docx): The Complaint represents unverified, adversarial assertions and litigation theories drafted by SkyVault's advocates. Pleading allegations—including assertions that Dr. Holt 'misappropriated' files, that PathForge 'mirrors' AeroCore, that Meridian 'induced' a breach of contract, or that trade secrets were 'first discovered' in July 2022—are formal claims that SkyVault carries the burden of proving under applicable federal and state standards. They do not constitute evidence.

2. Meridian Pre-Suit Response Letter (meridian-cd-response.docx): The April 5, 2024 letter represents outside counsel's pre-suit defensive posture and legal advocacy. While it formally articulates Meridian's positions—including categorical denials of infringement, assertions of independent development by Meridian engineering teams, and maintenance of robust compliance procedures—these statements are party contentions. They must be empirically substantiated through witness interviews, repository commit logs, and internal corporate records before they can be deployed as verified trial evidence.

3. PathForge White Paper Excerpt (pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx): The white paper excerpt is a public marketing and technical overview published in July 2022. It represents an excerpt of a stated 42-page technical document, omitting Section 6 (hardware integration specifications) and technical appendices. While it outlines high-level architectural concepts and marketing-oriented performance benchmarks, marketing descriptions frequently employ commercial puffery or simplified conceptual diagrams that diverge from actual low-level source code implementations. It cannot be treated as an admission of literal claim correspondence or as a complete technical blueprint of PathForge.

4. Holt Employment Agreement and Invention Assignment (holt-eciaa-agreement.docx): The ECIAA is an executed contract dated June 13, 2016, governing confidentiality and invention assignment between SkyVault and Dr. Holt. While the agreement establishes legal obligations—including perpetual trade secret protection, a 3-year confidentiality term for other confidential information (which expired on February 16, 2021), and a 12-month employee non-solicitation covenant (which expired on February 16, 2019)—the existence of the contract does not prove that Dr. Holt breached any covenant, that SkyVault's asserted information qualifies as legally protectable trade secrets, or that inventions developed at Meridian fall within its assignment scope. Furthermore, Exhibit A documents contractually acknowledged Prior Inventions that are expressly excluded from SkyVault's ownership.

5. SkyVault IT Forensic Log Extract (exhibit-f-forensic-log.xlsx): Exhibit F is a selective extract containing exactly 50 forensic events chosen from a total review population of 12,847 audit log events recorded between January 1, 2018, and February 28, 2018. The report was prepared by Hargrove Forensics Group on March 5, 2018, specifically for SkyVault's litigation counsel. This document reflects SkyVault's internal IT server logs and unilateral HR incident notes. It does not establish that Dr. Holt acted with unlawful intent, that the downloaded Confluence pages contained valid trade secrets, that the physical USB media was retained or accessed after Dr. Holt's departure, or that any downloaded data was ever transferred to, disclosed to, or utilized by Meridian Dynamics. Crucially, the remaining 12,797 events from the full review population have been omitted.

6. Unprovided March 12, 2024 Cease-and-Desist Letter: SkyVault's underlying March 12, 2024 cease-and-desist letter was NOT provided in the case materials. Counsel must strictly adhere to the mandate that no facts, demands, or assertions may be attributed to the March 12 correspondence beyond what is expressly documented in Complaint paragraph 61 and Meridian's April 5, 2024 response letter. Specifically, the record reflects only that the letter identified the '561, '227, and '889 patents, asserted trade secret and copyright claims, and demanded commercial cessation, a $15 million license fee, and a source code audit, without providing any claim charts or technical substantiation.

1.3 Integration of the Six Mandatory Lead Families

To ensure comprehensive coverage and seamless cross-examination potential, all interview questions across each witness category must integrate and bridge at least six central lead families identified from the source materials:

Lead Family 1: Dr. Holt's Employment and Access History at SkyVault: Encompasses Dr. Holt's hire date (June 13, 2016), job duties reporting to CEO Dr. Rajan Mehta, daily access to Confluence spaces (/SensorFusion/, /FlightPath/, /SwarmProtocol/, /HardwareIntegration/, /Business/CustomerData/), workstation SV-ENG-WS-014, the February 2018 bulk exports (Rows 27-32), the February 8/9, 2018 USB connection and file copy alert (Rows 33-35), access revocations on February 13, 2018 (Rows 41-44), the exit interview with HR Director K. Patel on February 15, 2018 (Row 46), laptop retention, and formal separation on February 16, 2018.

Lead Family 2: Dr. Holt's Disclosed Prior Work and Academic Baseline: Encompasses Dr. Holt's educational background (PhD in Robotics from Georgia Tech, 2015), the two Prior Inventions explicitly disclosed and excluded in Exhibit A of the ECIAA ('Autonomous Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm' and 'RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit' published on GitHub under MIT License), and the general skills, knowledge, and experience carved out under ECIAA Section 3.4.

Lead Family 3: PathForge's Development Starting Point and Architecture: Encompasses Meridian's founding timeline (incorporation on April 11, 2018, by Priya Chandrasekaran and Dr. Holt), the technical inception of PathForge from first principles, and the distinct, phased development cycles across independent modules: Multi-Sensor Fusion (Q3 2018 - Q4 2019), GPS-Denied Navigation (Q1 2019 - Q3 2020), Swarm Coordination (Q2 2019 - Q1 2021), commercial launch in September 2020, and the modular independence of the Navigation Module, Swarm Module, Analytics Dashboard, and Hardware Integration Layer.

Lead Family 4: White Paper Title, Authorship, and Representation Discrepancies: Encompasses the July 2022 technical white paper excerpt titled 'PathForge: Next-Generation Autonomous Navigation,' authored by Dr. Marcus Holt and the PathForge Engineering Team; its commercial/marketing character; the omission of Section 6 and appendices; and the significant textual and structural discrepancies between SkyVault's preliminary claim chart in Complaint Table 1 (citing non-existent sections such as 'Section 4.1 Threat Assessment Module' and 'Section 5.1 Flight Controller API') and the actual white paper text.

Lead Family 5: DroneNav and Other Public Academic / Open-Source Sources: Encompasses published literature and open-source projects foundational to autonomous navigation, specifically Dr. Elena Vasquez's 2016 IEEE paper on multi-sensor fusion, the DroneNav GitHub project (first committed August 15, 2017), Nakamura & Okonkwo (2015), and Ferreira et al. (2016). Counsel must examine each public source across eight distinct operational modes: awareness, citation, evaluation, cloning, dependency inclusion, modification, use, and non-use.

Lead Family 6: Pre-Suit Correspondence Chain and Procedural Milestones: Encompasses the receipt, internal routing, and handling of SkyVault's March 12, 2024 C&D letter; Meridian's formal response letter of April 5, 2024 (authored by Laura Brackwell and cc'ing VP of Legal Jordan Kessler); the absence of claim charts or technical proof from SkyVault; the six-month pre-suit silence before the October 2, 2024 Complaint; and SkyVault's extraordinary six-year delay between the March 5, 2018 forensic report and formal assertion of claims, bearing directly on laches and statute of limitations defenses under TUTSA and DTSA.

1.4 Conversion of Missing Records into Affirmative Investigation Inquiries

Methodological Directive: The five materials provided represent a highly restricted documentary universe. Critical categories of operational, engineering, and personnel evidence are entirely absent from the file. In accordance with strict investigative standards, counsel must NOT presume that unprovided documents support SkyVault's claims or substantiate Meridian's defenses. Instead, all missing records must be converted into affirmative interview verification questions and targeted document collection tasks. These missing categories include:

• Personnel & Exit Records: Dr. Holt's official personnel file at SkyVault, performance reviews, written job descriptions, the formal exit interview record, and any executed ECIAA Section 3.5 return/destruction certifications.

• Source Code Repositories: Complete Git/GitLab/Bitbucket commit histories, branches, pull request discussions, code review comments, and cryptographic author tags for Meridian's PathForge from inception (April 2018) to v1.0 release (September 2020).

• Engineering Development Records: Jira project tickets, architecture decision records (ADRs), internal engineering design specifications, hardware schematics, laboratory notebooks, and flight test data logs.

• Document Preservation & Hold Notices: Formal litigation hold notices issued by Meridian's legal department, employee distribution lists, signed acknowledgments, and IT audit records verifying the freezing of auto-deletion protocols.

• Internal Communications: Email archives, Slack/Microsoft Teams channel histories, calendar invitations, and executive meeting minutes from February 2018 through October 2024.

• IP Compliance Materials: Meridian's written employee handbook, IP onboarding policies, third-party proprietary information screening forms, and software composition analysis (SCA) scan logs (e.g., Black Duck, FOSSA, SonarQube).

• Complete Forensic Datasets: The full, unredacted 12,847-event audit log population referenced in Exhibit F, full disk images of workstation SV-ENG-WS-014, and forensic images of Dr. Holt's personal/Meridian computing devices.

• Technical AST / Diff Code Comparisons: Formal abstract syntax tree (AST) comparisons and line-by-line diffs between SkyVault's copyrighted AeroCore firmware files (`navfusion.c`, `pathoptengine.h`, `swarm_proto.cpp`) and PathForge source code.

SECTION II: WITNESS EXAMINATION OUTLINE — DR. MARCUS HOLT (CHIEF TECHNOLOGY OFFICER & CO-FOUNDER)

Dr. Marcus Holt is the pivotal individual spanning both companies, having served as a Senior Systems Engineer at SkyVault from June 2016 through February 2018 before co-founding Meridian Dynamics in April 2018 as Chief Technology Officer. In this initial round of privileged interviews, Dr. Holt's role is to provide a comprehensive, firsthand factual accounting of his technical responsibilities, access history, and departure circumstances at SkyVault, as well as the genuine technical genesis of Meridian's PathForge platform. His examination is vital to evaluating SkyVault's claims of bulk data misappropriation and copyright infringement against the verifiable history of his pre-existing academic expertise, contractual exclusions, and independent engineering contributions at Meridian.

INTERVIEW PROTOCOL & CREDIBILITY ASSESSMENT: EXAMINATION DIRECTIVE: All questions must be posed in an open-ended manner to elicit Dr. Holt's unvarnished factual recollections. Counsel must avoid leading phrasing on contested departure events. The examining attorney must observe how Dr. Holt handles document confrontations—particularly regarding Exhibit F forensic entries—to evaluate his credibility, composure, and viability as a key deposition and trial witness. Counsel must also confirm the existence, location, and preservation of any personal notes, records, or storage media.



2.1 Academic Background, Prior Inventions, and ECIAA Exhibit A Disclosures

Q1. Dr. Holt, please describe your doctoral research in robotics at the Georgia Institute of Technology, focusing on the specific algorithms, mathematical models, and software you developed prior to joining SkyVault in June 2016.

Source: holt-eciaa-agreement.docx, Recitals (p. 1) & Exhibit A (Table 0, Row 1) [establishing PhD degree (2015) and excluding 'Autonomous Ground Vehicle Path Planning Algorithm' (2014-2015)]; skyvault-complaint.docx ¶ 42 [alleging PhD background in robotics]; pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx Section 2 (p. 2) [referencing Dr. Holt's academic background shaping PathForge architecture].

Evidentiary purpose: Establish Dr. Holt's pre-existing, non-infringing academic foundation in path planning and autonomous systems; prove that his foundational algorithmic expertise was acquired prior to SkyVault and contractually excluded under ECIAA Section 5.3; refute SkyVault's allegation that his navigation expertise was derived from SkyVault.

Q2. What was the origin, scope, and public availability of the 'RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit' that you listed in Exhibit A of your SkyVault employment agreement, and where was that code hosted?

Source: holt-eciaa-agreement.docx, Exhibit A (Table 0, Row 2) [disclosing 'RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit (open-source)' published on GitHub under MIT License at github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal]; holt-eciaa-agreement.docx Section 2.1(i)-(ii) [excluding publicly available and previously known information from 'Confidential Information'].

Evidentiary purpose: Document that sensor calibration tools were authored by Dr. Holt and published open-source under an MIT License before joining SkyVault; establish that these methodologies were publicly accessible prior art that could not constitute SkyVault trade secrets under TUTSA or DTSA.

Q3. During your employment at SkyVault, did you introduce, modify, or reference your pre-existing RoboNav codebase or doctoral research in any SkyVault projects, and did anyone at SkyVault ever comment on or claim ownership of those tools?

Source: holt-eciaa-agreement.docx, Section 3.4 [expressly preserving employee's right to use general skills, knowledge, and industry information] and Section 5.3 [excluding Prior Inventions]; skyvault-complaint.docx ¶ 38(a)-(b) [asserting ownership of sensor fusion and path planning].

Evidentiary purpose: Clarify whether Dr. Holt's prior open-source software was integrated into SkyVault systems, and confirm that SkyVault had contemporaneous written notice of Dr. Holt's prior inventions without raising an ownership claim during his tenure.

2.2 SkyVault Employment Tenure, Reporting Lines, and System Access History

Q4. When you joined SkyVault as a Senior Systems Engineer on June 13, 2016, what were your specific engineering responsibilities, and how did your day-to-day workflow interact with SkyVault's CEO, Dr. Rajan Mehta?

Source: holt-eciaa-agreement.docx, Section 1.1 [defining position and duties reporting to CEO Dr. Rajan Mehta]; skyvault-complaint.docx ¶ 5, 21, 43 [alleging Dr. Mehta's background and Dr. Holt's hire date]; meridian-cd-response.docx ¶ 11 [asserting independent development].

Evidentiary purpose: Delineate Dr. Holt's actual R&D scope versus Dr. Mehta's architectural oversight; assess the division of labor between Dr. Mehta and Dr. Holt to evaluate inventorship and patent ownership issues under the '561, '227, and '889 patents.

Q5. Please describe the standard IT environment, user permissions, and directory access granted to you at SkyVault, including your use of the workstation SV-ENG-WS-014 and the internal Confluence knowledge workspace.

Source: exhibit-f-forensic-log.xlsx, Sheet 'Report Metadata' (Row 7) [defining scope as user 'mholt'] & Sheet 'Forensic Log' (Rows 1-26, Column 'Workstation Name' SV-ENG-WS-014, IP 10.10.42.118); skyvault-complaint.docx ¶ 44 [alleging broad access to AeroCore technology].

Evidentiary purpose: Establish whether Dr. Holt's access across Confluence engineering subspaces (/SensorFusion/, /FlightPath/, /SwarmProtocol/, /HardwareIntegration/) was ordinary, company-authorized system access consistent with his senior engineering duties, refuting claims of unauthorized intrusions.

SECTION V: RECOMMENDED INTERVIEW SEQUENCING AND CROSS-VERIFICATION STRATEGY

Investigative Rationale: A critical strategic determination in conducting an internal factual investigation is the sequencing of witness examinations. The order in which witnesses are interviewed directly governs counsel's ability to verify assertions against objective records, protect attorney-client privilege, prevent witness collusion or narrative adaptation, and progressively build factual leverage. Based on the evidentiary status of the available materials, the scope of privilege, and the comparative knowledge of the witnesses, the defense team recommends the following three-stage investigative sequence:

5.1 Recommended Investigative Sequence Overview

Sequential Order: Stage 1 (FIRST): Meridian Legal Lead (Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal)Stage 2 (SECOND): Meridian Technical Team (Module Architects & Lead Developers)Stage 3 (LAST): Dr. Marcus Holt (Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder)

CORE SEQUENCING METHODOLOGY: STRATEGIC JUSTIFICATION SUMMARY: Interviewing the Legal Lead first establishes an uncompromised document preservation baseline, secures corporate governance records, and identifies the relevant technical contributors without intruding into privileged legal opinions. Interviewing the Technical Team second establishes an objective, code-level record of independent development, commit histories, and open-source usage directly from the developers who wrote the software. Interviewing Dr. Marcus Holt last ensures that counsel possesses complete mastery over the objective documentary and codebase record, maximizing cross-examination leverage and preventing Dr. Holt from tailoring his testimony regarding the contested February 2018 forensic events.



5.2 Detailed Step-by-Step Rationale and Cross-Verification Mechanics

Stage 1 (First): Meridian Legal Lead (Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal)

Foundational Role: Examining Mr. Kessler as the opening interview serves three indispensable foundational functions:

• 1. Securing Preservation and Audit Readiness: Before substantive fact witnesses are interviewed—and before any risk of spoliation can be alleged—counsel must confirm that comprehensive, written litigation holds were properly issued, that auto-deletion schedules on email, Slack, and Git servers were suspended, and that forensic images of key custodian hardware were securely captured. Establishing this defensible preservation trail at the outset protects Meridian against spoliation sanctions under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 37(e).

• 2. Defining Privilege and Procedural Boundaries: Mr. Kessler is the corporate gatekeeper of legal communications. Interviewing him first allows outside counsel to delineate the exact boundaries between discoverable factual events (e.g., date of receipt of the March 12 C&D letter, employee onboarding forms, third-party software scans) and privileged legal work product (e.g., legal risk assessments, outside counsel advice, defense theories). This ensures all subsequent internal communications adhere strictly to privilege protocols.

• 3. Gathering Baseline Corporate & Personnel Documents: The Legal Lead can provide the foundational corporate records needed for subsequent interviews: standard employee PIIAs, employee handbooks, the complete pre-suit correspondence file, ordinary-course patent clearance searches, and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan reports. Furthermore, Mr. Kessler can supply an objective organizational chart identifying which engineers worked on which specific modules, eliminating reliance on Dr. Holt's subjective characterization of the team.

Stage 2 (Second): Meridian Technical Team (Module Architects & Lead Developers)

Objective Technical Baseline: Examining the technical team prior to Dr. Holt provides an untainted, empirical engineering baseline:

• 1. Independent Verification of Code Provenance: Module architects and lead developers possess direct, firsthand knowledge of how the code was conceived, designed, and implemented. By examining them before Dr. Holt, counsel obtains an authentic, uncolored account of the engineering process. Their testimony will establish whether developers wrote the code from scratch, what academic literature they consulted, and whether Dr. Holt provided high-level architectural requirements or hands-on code.

• 2. Interrogation of Git Commit Histories and Repositories: With repository commit logs and Jira tickets in hand (secured during Stage 1), counsel can review specific commits, author tags, and branch mergers directly with the authors. This creates an objective timeline showing that the Sensor Fusion module (Q3 2018 - Q4 2019), GPS-denied VIO module (Q1 2019 - Q3 2020), and Swarm protocol (Q2 2019 - Q1 2021) were developed incrementally over several years, conclusively disproving SkyVault's theory of a wholesale 2018 code drop.

• 3. Methodical Evaluation of Public Literature Across Eight Modes: The technical team can speak authoritatively to how Vasquez (2016), DroneNav (GitHub 2017), Nakamura & Okonkwo (2015), and Ferreira et al. (2016) were actually treated in practice across all eight operational modes (awareness, citation, evaluation, cloning, dependency inclusion, modification, use, non-use). This confirms that open-source tools were either evaluated as prior art or segregated, and that no proprietary code was copied.

• 4. Definitive Code Diff Verification: Technical leads can verify that SkyVault's asserted AeroCore firmware files (`navfusion.c`, `pathoptengine.h`, `swarm_proto.cpp`) are completely absent from PathForge, establishing an affirmative technical record before Dr. Holt is examined.

Stage 3 (Last): Dr. Marcus Holt (Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder)

Confrontation and Testing: Dr. Marcus Holt must be interviewed last to achieve maximum cross-examination effectiveness and test his credibility against established facts:

• 1. Full Command of the Documentary Record: By the time counsel interviews Dr. Holt, counsel will possess the complete corporate governance file from Legal, the full Git repository commit history and Jira logs from Engineering, and the verified testimony of module leads regarding who wrote each line of code. Counsel can examine Dr. Holt with complete mastery of the facts, ensuring that any gaps, exaggerations, or inconsistencies in his narrative can be immediately identified and probed.

• 2. Preventing Tailored Testimony: If Dr. Holt were interviewed first, he might be tempted to shape his account of PathForge's development to fit a defensive narrative, or minimize his involvement in certain areas. By interviewing the technical team first, counsel establishes an objective factual record that Dr. Holt cannot rewrite. Counsel can test whether Dr. Holt's recollection of his role aligns with what the codebase and his developers actually show.

• 3. Surgical Confrontation on Forensic Log Events (Exhibit F): Dr. Holt is the sole individual who can explain the February 8/9, 2018 bulk transfer of 4,700 files to the SanDisk Ultra 128GB USB device, the local Confluence downloads (Rows 27-32), the access revocation on February 13, and the exit interview with HR Director Patel on February 15. Because counsel will already know from Stages 1 and 2 that none of those files ever surfaced in Meridian's repositories, counsel can confront Dr. Holt on the physical disposition and chain of custody of that USB device from a position of total tactical strength.

• 4. Deposition Preparation and Credibility Assessment: Because Dr. Holt will unquestionably be SkyVault's primary deposition target and the central witness at trial, conducting his interview last allows counsel to evaluate his demeanor, composure, and truthfulness under rigorous, adversarial cross-examination conditions. Counsel can identify potential vulnerabilities and begin formulating comprehensive witness preparation strategies.
